archetypes.name: dyn-review-loop-regression
archetypes.rationale: Verify removing post-apply checks from _step5_post_round_gates preserves convergence/stall routing and leaves no dangling references
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/review_and_fix.py _step5_post_round_gates and its single caller in the Step 5 review loop. The post-apply full make py-lint/py-test run and the lint-fix retry loop were removed; confirm the surviving substantiality, bulk-skip-ratio (stall), cap-hit, and complete return paths still drive round advancement and stall routing exactly as before. Check there are no remaining references to the deleted helpers (_run_relevant_checks_captured, _run_lint_fix_loop, _binary_flag, _checks_result_capture, _lint_fix_* helpers) anywhere in review_and_fix.py, and that the orphaned `import checks` was removed. Verify Step 3 and Step 6 still cover the relevant-checks surface so removing per-apply checks does not drop coverage. Confirm the updated convergence tests still assert cap-hit and continue outcomes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
